description.value: Antico Pizza Napoletana is a family-owned Neapolitan pizzeria officially certified by the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana in Naples and ranked #1 in Kelowna and British Columbia, with a top-50 North America ranking from Top 50 Italy. Every pizza is handmade from naturally leavened dough and baked in a wood-fired oven custom-built in Naples using imported Italian ingredients including San Marzano tomatoes and Mozzarella di Bufala. The restaurant sits in downtown Kelowna with a patio one block from Okanagan Lake, placing it directly on a natural cycling route through the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms the OSM address (347 Bernard Avenue, Kelowna, BC V1Y6N6), phone (250.717.3741), and business identity. Counter service and Skip The Dishes delivery confirm takeout; the menu clearly lists multiple vegetarian pizzas. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A highly rated, certified Neapolitan pizzeria in downtown Kelowna one block from Okanagan Lake — a premier cycling corridor — with counter service well-suited to touring cyclists; a strong Food & Drink listing despite unconfirmed bike-specific amenities.

Takeout.detail: Counter service format (no reservations needed); delivery via Skip The Dishes; frozen pizzas sold in-house for takeaway

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian pizzas on menu: Margherita, Marinara (no cheese), al Greco (feta, olives, green pepper, red onion), Tartufino (truffle cream, mushroom, arugula); vegetarian toppings available à la carte. No vegan or gluten-free options explicitly mentioned
